title: Permission to Deploy
story: The deployment script contains all the right commands and none of the right permissions. Security would like fewer surprises today.
objective: Set /srv/release/deploy.sh so its owner can read, write, and execute it; its group can read and execute it; and everyone else has no access (mode 750).
hints: In octal, read=4, write=2, and execute=1. Add them for owner, group, and others.
explanation: Mode 750 means rwx for the owner, r-x for the group, and --- for others. Grant only the access a file actually needs.
